source.primary_witnesses: 11Q12 preserves SPARSE FRAGMENTS touching the Mastema material in ch 10. Greek not preserved for this chapter (Epiphanius geographical material ends after ch 9). Ge'ez (Charles 1902 + VanderKam 1989) is primary.
source.verificationStatus: best-effort reconstruction; verification pending against García Martínez et al. 1998 DJD XXIII + VanderKam 1989 + VanderKam 2018 Hermeneia.
source.fetchedFrom: García Martínez et al. 1998 DJD XXIII; VanderKam 1989 CSCO 510-511; Charles 1902; VanderKam 2018 Hermeneia.
source.citation: García Martínez et al. 1998 DJD XXIII; VanderKam 1989 CSCO 510-511; VanderKam 2018 Hermeneia; Charles 1902; Reed 2005 Fallen Angels and the History of Judaism and Christianity.
source.paleography_note: CHAPTER 10 — **MASTEMA + THE GIANTS-BECOME-EVIL-SPIRITS DEMONOLOGY (vv 1-14) + NOAH'S MEDICINAL-BOOK (vv 10-14) + DEATH OF NOAH (vv 15-17) + TOWER OF BABEL (vv 18-26) + CANAAN'S TERRITORIAL TRESPASS REPEAT (vv 27-34).** **MAJOR CROSS-CORPUS CHAPTER.** **Bidirectional with v2.66.0 glossary entry `giants-become-evil-spirits-demonology-1-enoch-15-cross-corpus-jub-10-tertullian`** (vv 1-14 contain THE foundational text for the giants-become-evil-spirits etiology). **MASTEMA introduced here as the prince of evil spirits / Satan-figure.**

verses.text_geez: ወበካልእ፡ ሰቡዕ፡ ለዝንቱ፡ ኢዮቤልዉ፡ አኀዙ፡ ርኩሳን፡ መናፍስት፡ ያስሕትዎሙ፡ ለደቂቀ፡ ደቂቀ፡ ኖኅ፡ ወይትዐርጉ፡ ላዕሌሆሙ፡ ወያስሕትዎሙ፡
verses.translit: wa-ba-kāləʾ sabuʿ la-zəntu ʾiyobēləwu ʾaḫazu rəkusān manāfəst yāsḥətəwomu la-daqiqa daqiqa Noḫ wa-yətʿarrəgu lāʿlēhomu wa-yāsḥətəwomu
verses.witness_primary: Ge'ez (Charles 1902 10:1; VanderKam 1989) — 11Q12 lacunose at this verse
verses.notes: **THE EVIL SPIRITS (rəkusān manāfəst) BEGIN TO LEAD NOAH'S GRANDCHILDREN ASTRAY.** **MAJOR CROSS-CORPUS — INTRODUCES THE POST-FLOOD DEMONIC PROBLEM.** Evil spirits = the disembodied spirits of the dead giants (named explicitly in v. 5 below). Bidirectional with v2.66.0 glossary entry `giants-become-evil-spirits-demonology-1-enoch-15-cross-corpus-jub-10-tertullian`. **CROSS-CORPUS**: cf. 1 En 15:8-12 (the foundational giants-become-evil-spirits text); cf. Mark 5 (Legion); cf. Matt 12:43-45 (unclean spirits seeking habitation); cf. Tertullian Apol. 22; cf. Justin Martyr 2 Apol. 5.

verses.text_geez: ወመጽኡ፡ ኀበ፡ ኖኅ፡ አቡሆሙ፡ ወዜነውዎ፡ በእንተ፡ መናፍስት፡ እለ፡ ያስሕትዎሙ፡ ወያዕውርዎሙ፡ ወይቀትልዎሙ፡ ለደቂቀ፡ ደቂቆሙ፡
verses.translit: wa-maṣʾu ḫaba Noḫ ʾabbuhomu wa-zēnnawəwo ba-ʾənta manāfəst ʾəlla yāsḥətəwomu wa-yāʿwərəwomu wa-yəqtələwomu la-daqiqa daqiqomu
verses.notes: **Noah's sons report to him: the evil spirits are LEADING ASTRAY + BLINDING + KILLING their grandchildren.** **CROSS-CORPUS — DEMONIC AFFLICTIONS**: leading astray (idolatry), blinding (sickness/divination), killing (mortal harm). The triple-mode of demonic action picked up in NT demonology + early Christian healing-literature.

verses.text_geez: ወጸለየ፡ ቅድመ፡ እግዚእ፡ አምላኩ፡ ወይቤ፡ አምላከ፡ መናፍስት፡ እለ፡ ውስተ፡ ኵሉ፡ ሥጋ፡ ዘገበርከ፡ ሊተ፡ ምሕረተ፡ ወዘአድኀንከ፡ ኪያየ፡ ወለደቂቅየ፡ እምነ፡ ማይ፡ አይኅ፡ ወአልቦ፡ ዘይትገበር፡ ላዕለ፡ መውዓ፡ መንገለ፡ ሰብእ፡ ኬዱ፡ ሎሙ፡ ለመናፍስት፡ እኩያን፡ ወአልቦ፡ ዘይትገበር፡ ላዕለ፡ ደቂቅነ፡ ኪያሆሙ፡ ይትኰነኑ፡ መናፍስት፡ ዘሕያው፡ ወዘርእስ፡ ወዘረሰዩ፡ ለሕይወት
verses.translit: wa-ṣallaya qədma ʾəgziʾ ʾamlāku wa-yəbē ʾamlāka manāfəst ʾəlla wəsta kwəlu śəgā zagabarkka lita məḥrata wa-zaʾadḫankka kiyāya wa-la-daqiqəya ʾəm-nə māy ʾāyəḫ wa-ʾalbo zayətgabbar lāʿla mawʿā mangala sabʾ kēdu lomu la-manāfəst ʾəkuyān wa-ʾalbo zayətgabbar lāʿla daqiqəna kiyāhomu yətkwannanu manāfəst zaḥəyāw wa-zarəʾəs wa-zarassayu la-ḥəywat
verses.notes: **Noah's prayer: 'God of spirits in all flesh — let the evil spirits be judged and may my children be protected.'** **CROSS-CORPUS — 'GOD OF SPIRITS IN ALL FLESH'**: cf. Num 16:22, Num 27:16 ('the God of the spirits of all flesh' — אלהי הרוחות לכל בשר); cf. Heb 12:9 ('Father of spirits'). The divine title positions God as ruler over the spirit-realm. **The prayer pattern**: invocation + appeal to prior mercy (Flood-deliverance) + petition for present protection — a model intercessory prayer.

verses.text_geez: ወአንተ፡ ባርክ፡ ኪያየ፡ ወደቂቅየ፡ ከመ፡ ንብዛኅ፡ ወንምልእ፡ ምድረ፡ ወባርክ፡ ዘርእነ፡ ለትኩን፡ ይትደምሩ፡ መንፈስ፡ ቅዱስ፡ ዘወሀብከ፡ ሊተ፡ ወለደቂቅየ፡ ከመ፡ ኢይትገሐሡ፡ እምነ፡ ጻድቅ፡ እምነ፡ ይእዜ፡ ወእስከ፡ ለዓለም፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾanta bārəkə kiyāya wa-daqiqəya kama nəbzāḫ wa-nəmləʾ mədra wa-bārəkə zarʾana la-tkun yətdammaru manfas qəddusə zawahabəka lita wa-la-daqiqəya kama ʾi-yətgaḥaśu ʾəm-nə ṣādəq ʾəm-nə yəʾəzē wa-ʾəska la-ʿālam
verses.notes: **'Bless me and my children with the HOLY SPIRIT you gave to me, that we may not turn aside from righteousness forever.'** **CROSS-CORPUS — INDWELLING HOLY SPIRIT**: cf. Jub 1:23 (above); cf. 1QS 4:20-22 (Qumran); cf. Ezek 36:27. **The 'holy spirit given to Noah'** is one of the EARLIEST attestations of indwelling-Spirit theology.

verses.text_geez: ወአንተ፡ ኣአምር፡ ዘገብሩ፡ ላዕለ፡ መዋዕልየ፡ ወእለ፡ መናፍስት፡ ሕያው፡ ሐንበሊ፡ ኬሊዎሙ፡ ወቦጥ፡ መሐሎሙ፡ ወአስርሙ፡ ለመካን፡ ኩናኔ፡ ወኢይትገበር፡ ሙስና፡ ላዕለ፡ ደቂቀ፡ ግብርከ፡ አምላኪየ፡ እስመ፡ ኪያሆሙ፡ መነንከ፡ ወአስተአተትከ፡ ለርእስከ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾanta ʾaʾammər zagabru lāʿla mawāʿəlya wa-ʾəlla manāfəst ḥəyāw ḫanbali kēliwomu wa-boṭ maḥalomu wa-ʾasərmu la-makān kwənnānē wa-ʾi-yətgabbar musnā lāʿla daqiqa gəbrəka ʾamlākiya ʾəsma kiyāhomu mannanəkka wa-ʾastaʾtatəkka la-rəʾəsəka lāʿla mədr
verses.notes: **Noah's prayer continues: 'YOU KNOW WHAT THE WATCHERS DID IN MY DAYS, AND THESE SPIRITS — THE LIVING ONES — BIND, IMPRISON, RESTRAIN.'** **MAJOR CROSS-CORPUS — EXPLICIT IDENTIFICATION**: the evil spirits = the LIVING ones who came from the bodies of the dead giants. **Bidirectional with v2.66.0 giants-become-evil-spirits glossary entry.** **CROSS-CORPUS**: 1 En 15:8-12 (the foundational text: 'the giants who were born from spirit and flesh — they shall be called evil spirits on the earth, and on the earth shall be their dwelling. Evil spirits proceed from their bodies'). Tertullian Apol. 22 + Justin 2 Apol. 5 follow this etiology.

verses.text_geez: ወይእዜኒ፡ መናፍስት፡ ዘሕያው፡ እምነ፡ ሥጋሆሙ፡ ለኄሊያን፡ እሙንቱ፡ ኩናኔ፡ ይትገበር፡ ላዕለ፡ ኪያሆሙ፡ ወወድቁ፡ ብእሲሁ፡ ወብእሲቱ፡ እምነ፡ መካናቲሆሙ፡ ወያስሕትዎሙ፡ ለደቂቀ፡ ሰብእ፡ ወአስተአተተ፡ ኪያሆሙ፡ ለመካናት፡ ኵናኔ፡
verses.translit: wa-yəʾəzēni manāfəst zaḥəyāw ʾəm-nə śəgāhomu la-Ḥeliyān ʾəmuntu kwənnānē yətgabbar lāʿla kiyāhomu wa-wadqu bəʾəsihu wa-bəʾəsitu ʾəm-nə makānātihomu wa-yāsḥətəwomu la-daqiqa sabʾ wa-ʾastaʾtata kiyāhomu la-makānāt kwənnānē
verses.notes: **'NOW THESE SPIRITS PROCEED FROM THE FLESH OF THE GIANTS' — explicit etiological formula. They lead astray Noah's children.** Bidirectional with v2.66.0 giants-become-evil-spirits entry. Locus classicus.

verses.text_geez: ወአዘዘ፡ እግዚእ፡ መላእክተ፡ ኩናኔ፡ ከመ፡ ይዕቅብዎሙ፡ ለመናፍስት፡ ኩኖ፡ ይኩኑ፡ ይትዐለዉ፡ መካናተ፡ ኩናኔ፡ ለመናፍስት፡ ኩናኔ፡ ኄሊያን፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾazaza ʾəgziʾ malāʾəkta kwənnānē kama yəʿqəbəwomu la-manāfəst kwono yəkunu yətʿalawə makānāta kwənnānē la-manāfəst kwənnānē Ḥeliyān
verses.notes: **God commands the angels-of-judgment to bind the evil spirits.** The angel-of-presence orders confinement of demons.

verses.text_geez: ወመጽአ፡ መልአከ፡ መናፍስት፡ መስቴማ፡ ወይቤ፡ እግዚእነ፡ ፈጣሪ፡ ኅድጎሙ፡ እምኔሆሙ፡ ቅድሜየ፡ ወይሰምዑ፡ ቃልየ፡ ወይግበሩ፡ ኵሎ፡ ዘእብል፡ ኪያሆሙ፡ እስመ፡ እመ፡ ኢተሐድጉ፡ ሊተ፡ ሕላፍ፡ ስልጣን፡ ኪያሆሙ፡ ኢይክል፡ ገቢረ፡ ሥልጣን፡ ላዕለ፡ ደቂቀ፡ ሰብእ፡ እስመ፡ ኪያሆሙ፡ ኪያሆሙ፡ ለስሕተተ፡ ወለመሕየቅ፡ ቅድመ፡ ኩናኔየ፡ እስመ፡ ብዙኅ፡ ዐመፃሆሙ፡ ለደቂቀ፡ ሰብእ፡
verses.translit: wa-maṣʾa malʾaka manāfəst Mastēmā wa-yəbē ʾəgziʾəna faṭāri ḫədəgomu ʾəmənnehomu qədmēya wa-yəsmaʿu qāləya wa-yəgbaru kwəlo zaʾəbəl kiyāhomu ʾəsma ʾəmma ʾi-taḥadgu lita ḥəlāf səlṭān kiyāhomu ʾi-yəkəl gabira səlṭān lāʿla daqiqa sabʾ ʾəsma kiyāhomu kiyāhomu la-səḥtata wa-la-maḥyaq qədma kwənnānēya ʾəsma bəzuḫ ʿamaḍāhomu la-daqiqa sabʾ
verses.notes: **MASTEMA APPEARS — petitions God to retain a tenth of the evil spirits.** **MAJOR CROSS-CORPUS — MASTEMA INTRODUCED.** Mastema = the chief of the evil spirits = Satan-equivalent. **Hebrew etymology: מַשְׂטֵמָה Mastema = 'animosity, accusation' — cf. Hos 9:7-8, where 'mastemah' is used for hostility against the prophet.** **CROSS-CORPUS**: cf. Jub 11:5, 11:11, 17:16, 18:9-12, 19:28, 48:2, 48:9-12, 48:15, 49:2 (Mastema throughout Jubilees); cf. 1QS 3:13-4:26 (Belial / spirit of darkness in Qumran); cf. CD 16:5 (Mastema). **The bargain — Mastema is allowed to keep 1/10 of the evil spirits to torment sinful humanity — is a Jubilees-distinctive 'theological economy of evil.' This explains both the persistence of demonic affliction AND its containment.**

verses.text_geez: ወይቤ፡ ዘዘ፡ ዐሥሮሙ፡ የሐድጉ፡ ቦቱ፡ ቅድሜሁ፡ ወዘዘ፡ ተስዐሙ፡ ያውርዱ፡ ውስተ፡ መካን፡ ኩናኔ፡
verses.translit: wa-yəbē zaza ʿaśromu yaḥadgu bottu qədmēhu wa-zaza tasʿomu yāwrədu wəsta makān kwənnānē
verses.notes: **God grants Mastema 1/10 of the evil spirits; 9/10 sent to the place of judgment.** **THE 1/10 BARGAIN.** The remaining tenth-portion explains the continued existence of demonic afflictions on earth. cf. b. Pesahim 109b-112b (rabbinic demonology — similar limited-evil-spirit framework).

verses.text_geez: ወአዘዘ፡ አሐደ፡ እምነ፡ መላእክተ፡ ቅዱስ፡ ከመ፡ ይማህሮ፡ ለኖኅ፡ ኵሎ፡ ፈውሰ፡ እስመ፡ ያአምር፡ ከመ፡ ኢይሕወሩ፡ በቅዱስ፡ ጽድቅ፡ ወይትገበር፡ ላዕለ፡ ኵሉ፡ ኪያሁ፡ ለፈውስ፡ በከመ፡ ኖኅ፡ ጻድቅ፡ ዘይምሕር፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾazaza ʾaḥada ʾəm-nə malāʾəkta qəddus kama yəmaḥharo la-Noḫ kwəlo fawəsa ʾəsma yāʾammər kama ʾi-yəḥwaru ba-qəddusə ṣədq wa-yətgabbar lāʿla kwəlu kiyāhu la-fawəsə ba-kama Noḫ ṣādəq zayəməḥər
verses.notes: **ANGEL OF HEALING TEACHES NOAH ALL MEDICINE.** **MAJOR CROSS-CORPUS — THE FOUNDATIONAL ANGELIC-MEDICINE ETIOLOGY.** **CROSS-CORPUS**: cf. Sir 38:1-15 (physician honored, medicines from God); cf. Tobit 6, 11 (Raphael's medicinal instructions); cf. Sefer ha-Razim (medieval medical-angelic literature). **Noah as the FIRST POST-FLOOD PHYSICIAN.** The angelic-medicine tradition counters Watcher-pharmacology (cf. 1 En 8:3, where Watchers teach drugs).

verses.text_geez: ወአዘዝነ፡ ኖኅ፡ ኵሎ፡ ፈውሰ፡ በጥቡዕ፡ ለዕፀው፡ ምድር፡ በከመ፡ መሐርነ፡ ኪያሁ፡ ለፈውስ፡ ኵሉ፡ መድኀኒተ፡ መናፍስት፡ እኩያን
verses.translit: wa-ʾazazna Noḫ kwəlo fawəsa ba-ṭəbuʿə la-ʿəḍaw mədr ba-kama maḥarna kiyāhu la-fawəsə kwəlu madḫənita manāfəst ʾəkuyān
verses.notes: **Noah taught all medicines from earthly trees — REMEDIES against evil spirits.** **CROSS-CORPUS — HERBAL ANTI-DEMONIC PHARMACOLOGY**: cf. Tobit 8:1-3 (smoke from fish-liver expels demon); cf. Josephus Ant. 8.46-48 (Solomon's anti-demon herbalism); cf. T. Solomon (Christian-era demonology-pharmacology).

verses.text_geez: ወጸሐፍዎ፡ ኖኅ፡ ኵሎ፡ በውስተ፡ መጽሐፍ፡ በከመ፡ መሐርናሁ፡ ላዕለ፡ ኵሉ፡ ግዕዘ፡ ፈውስ፡ ወአሰረ፡ መናፍስት፡ እኩያን፡ ላዕለ፡ ደቂቀ፡ ኖኅ፡
verses.translit: wa-ṣaḥafəwo Noḫ kwəlo ba-wəsta maṣḥaf ba-kama maḥarnāhu lāʿla kwəlu gəʿza fawəsə wa-ʾasara manāfəst ʾəkuyān lāʿla daqiqa Noḫ
verses.notes: **NOAH WRITES A MEDICINAL BOOK — the SEFER REFUOT.** **MAJOR — THE PROTO-MEDICINAL-BOOK TRADITION.** Noah's medical book is the prototype of the SEFER REFUOT mentioned in rabbinic literature (m. Pesaḥim 4:9, b. Pesaḥim 56a: 'Hezekiah hid the Sefer Refuot'). **CROSS-CORPUS**: cf. b. Pesaḥim 56a; cf. T. Solomon. **Noah's medical book = ANGELICALLY-REVEALED ETHICAL MEDICINE — the legitimate counterpart to forbidden Watcher-pharmacology.**

verses.text_geez: ወወሀቦ፡ ለሴም፡ ወልዱ፡ ኄረ፡ ኵሎ፡ መጻሕፍተ፡ ዘጸሐፈ፡ እስመ፡ ኪያሁ፡ ያፈቅር፡ እምነ፡ ኵሉ፡ ደቂቁ፡
verses.translit: wa-wahabō la-Sēm waldu ḫera kwəlo maṣāḥəfta zaṣaḥafa ʾəsma kiyāhu yāfaqqər ʾəm-nə kwəlu daqiqu
verses.notes: **Noah's books transmitted to SHEM (his favorite).** **CROSS-CORPUS — SHEMIC BOOK-TRANSMISSION**: the Hebrew-line inherits the medicinal + scribal tradition. cf. 1 En 81:5-6 (Enoch to Methuselah); cf. Jub 7:38-39 (Enochic chain). **The book-transmission chain: Enoch → Methuselah → Noah → Shem.**

verses.text_geez: ወመጻሕፍት፡ ዘሄኖክ፡ ወዘኖኅ፡ ዕቁባት፡ ቦቱ፡ ለሴም፡
verses.translit: wa-maṣāḥəft zaHenok wa-zaNoḫ ʿəqubāt bottu la-Sēm
verses.notes: **ENOCHIC AND NOACHIC BOOKS DEPOSITED WITH SHEM.** Confirms the chain. **MAJOR — THE ENOCHIC + NOACHIC SCRIPTURE TRADITION GROUNDED HISTORICALLY.** Legitimates the pseudepigraphic Enoch literature as ancient + authentically transmitted. cf. 4 Ezra 14:44-46.

verses.text_geez: ወበ፪ ኢዮቤልዉ፡ ካልእ፡ ለ፪ ኢዮቤልዉ፡ ካልእ፡ ሣልስ፡ ሰቡዕ፡ ሞተ፡ ኖኅ፡ ፱፻፶ ዓመት፡ ኮኖ፡ በሕይወቱ፡ ፲ ኢዮቤልዋተ፡ ወ፪ ሰሙን፡ ወ፭ ዓመተ፡
verses.translit: wa-ba-2 ʾiyobēləwu kāləʾ la-2 ʾiyobēləwu kāləʾ śāləs sabuʿ mota Noḫ 950 ʿāmat kono ba-ḥəywatu 10 ʾiyobēləwāta wa-2 samun wa-5 ʿāmata
verses.notes: **Death of Noah at 950 years.** cf. Gen 9:29.

verses.text_geez: ወአልቦ፡ ዘመዋዕለ፡ መዋዕለ፡ ዓመት፡ ለመዋዕለ፡ ዓመት፡ ቀዳማዊ፡ ለሐሬሁ፡ መንበሩ፡ ብእሲ፡ ዘይነብር፡ በምድር፡ ኪያሁ፡ ጻድቅ፡ ወመንፈሰ፡ ቅዱስ፡ ቦቱ፡ ሰብእ፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾalbo zamawāʿəla mawāʿəla ʿāmat la-mawāʿəla ʿāmat qadāmāwi la-ḥarrēhu manbaru bəʾəsi zayənabbər ba-mədr kiyāhu ṣādəq wa-manfasa qəddusə bottu sabʾ
verses.notes: **Noah was unique among all humans for righteousness.** Eulogy of Noah's righteousness.

verses.text_geez: ወእምነ፡ መዋዕለ፡ ሄኖክ፡ ኢኮነ፡ ካልእ፡ እምነ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ ደቂቀ፡ ሰብእ፡ ዘይነበር፡ ለለ፡ ዓመት፡ ዘይኬዕው፡ ለሎቱ፡ ለቤት፡ ለትውልዱ፡ ኖኅ፡ እምነ፡ መዋዕለ፡ ሄኖክ፡ እመ፡ ኢተወሀበ፡ ለሎቱ፡ ዘ፰ መዋዕለ፡ ኢዮቤልዉ፡ ምስለ፡ ቤቱ፡ ለትውልዱ፡ ለነፈል፡ ምድር፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾəm-nə mawāʿəla Henok ʾi-kona kāləʾ ʾəm-nə kwəlomu daqiqa sabʾ zayənabbar la-la-ʿāmat zayəkēʿawə la-lottu la-bēt la-təwludu Noḫ ʾəm-nə mawāʿəla Henok ʾəmma ʾi-tawahaba la-lottu za-8 mawāʿəla ʾiyobēləwu məsla bētu la-təwludu la-nafal mədr
verses.notes: **Eulogistic comparison: Enoch + Noah as preeminent righteous men.**

verses.text_geez: ወበ፴ ወ፫ ኢዮቤልዉ፡ ቀዳማዊ፡ ሰቡዕ፡ በቀዳማዊ፡ ዓመት፡ ለዝንቱ፡ ኢዮቤልዉ፡ ነሥእዎ፡ ለፋሌቅ፡ ብእሲተ፡ ስማ፡ ሎሙና፡ ወለተ፡ ሲነዐር፡ ብእሲተ፡ ወወለደት፡ ሎቱ፡ ወልደ፡ በራብዕ፡ ዓመት፡ ለዝንቱ፡ ሰቡዕ፡ ወሰመዮ፡ ስሞ፡ ሬዑ፡ ወይቤ፡ ናሁ፡ እኩይ፡ ኮኑ፡ ደቂቀ፡ ሰብእ፡ በምክር፡ እኩይ፡ ለሐነጽ፡ ርእሰ፡ ሎሙ፡ ሀገረ፡ ወማኅፈደ፡ በምድር፡ ሺንዐር፡
verses.translit: wa-ba-33 ʾiyobēləwu qadāmāwi sabuʿ ba-qadāmāwi ʿāmat la-zəntu ʾiyobēləwu naśʾəwo la-Fālēq bəʾəsita səmā Lomuna walatta Sinaʿar bəʾəsita wa-waladat lottu walda ba-rābəʿ ʿāmat la-zəntu sabuʿ wa-samayō səmō Rēʿu wa-yəbē nāhu ʾəkkuy konu daqiqa sabʾ ba-məkr ʾəkuy la-ḥanaḍ rəʾəsa lomu hagara wa-māḫfada ba-mədr Šinʿar
verses.notes: **Birth of REU — Peleg names him 'because mankind is becoming evil' — building tower in Shinar.** **MAJOR CROSS-CORPUS — TOWER OF BABEL begins here.** cf. Gen 11:1-9.

verses.text_geez: ወወፅኡ፡ እምነ፡ ምድረ፡ አራራት፡ መንገለ፡ ምሥራቅ፡ ኀበ፡ ሺንዐር፡ እስመ፡ በመዋዕለ፡ ሎሙ፡ ሐነጹ፡ ሀገረ፡ ወማኅፈደ፡ ወይቤሉ፡ ንዕርግ፡ ቦቱ፡ ሰማየ፡
verses.translit: wa-waḍʾu ʾəm-nə mədra ʾArārāt mangala məsərāq ḫaba Šinʿar ʾəsma ba-mawāʿəlu lomu ḥanaḍu hagara wa-māḫfada wa-yəbēlu nəʿrəg bottu samāya
verses.notes: **Migration from Ararat to Shinar; tower-building begins; 'let us ascend to heaven.'** **CROSS-CORPUS**: cf. Gen 11:1-4.

verses.text_geez: ወአኀዙ፡ ይኅንጹ፡ ወበራብዕ፡ ሰሙን፡ አዕተቡ፡ በእሳት፡ ዘመባልሕት፡ ለነዲቅ፡ ኪያሆሙ፡ ወለቅርጻን፡ ኮኖሙ፡ ጥንቃቀ፡ ሰፈት፡ እንተ፡ ይነጽሕ፡ እምነ፡ ባሕር፡ ወእምነ፡ ማየ፡ ማእምቃተ፡ ዘሺንዐር፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾaḫazu yəḫənəḍu wa-ba-rābəʿ samun ʾaʿtabu ba-ʾəsāt zamabāləḥt la-nadiq kiyāhomu wa-la-qərṣān konomu ṭənqāqa safat ʾənta yənaṣṣəḥ ʾəm-nə bāḥr wa-ʾəm-nə māya māʾəmqāta zaŠinʿar
verses.notes: **Construction with fire-baked bricks + bitumen.** Direct citation of Gen 11:3.

verses.text_geez: ወሐነጹ፡ ኪያሁ፡ ፵ ወ፫ ዓመተ፡ ኮኑ፡ የሐንጹ፡ ኪያሁ፡ ስፍሐቱ፡ ፪ ምእት፡ ወ፴ ብእድ፡ ወቆሙ፡ ሰፈርዎ፡ ቍጻይዎ፡ ካዕበ፡ ለርእስ፡ ዓሥር፡ መንበር፡ ጥቅም፡ መንበሮ፡
verses.translit: wa-ḥanaḍu kiyāhu 43 ʿāmata konu yaḥanəḍu kiyāhu səfḥatu 2 məʾət wa-30 bəʾəd wa-qomu safarəwo quwəṣayəwo kāʿba la-rəʾəsa ʿaśr manbar ṭəqəm manbaro
verses.notes: **Tower built for 43 years, width 203 brick-courses, height 10× cubits (precise Jubilees-arithmetic).** **JUBILEES-DISTINCTIVE — ARCHITECTURAL DIMENSIONS GIVEN.** cf. various rabbinic + cosmographic Tower-of-Babel traditions.

verses.text_geez: ወይቤ፡ እግዚእ፡ አምላክነ፡ ናሁ፡ ሕዝብ፡ አሐዱ፡ ወልሳን፡ አሐዱ፡ ለኵሎሙ፡ ወዝንቱ፡ አኀዙ፡ ይግበሩ፡ ወአልቦ፡ ዘይክሎሙ፡ ናሁ፡ ንረድ፡ ወንባልኆሙ፡ ልሳኖሙ፡ ከመ፡ ኢይስምዑ፡ አሐዱ፡ ቃለ፡ ካልኡ፡ ወይዘረዉ፡ ውስተ፡ መካናት፡ ወውስተ፡ ሕዘባት፡ ወኢይትባአስ፡ ለሎሙ፡ ካዕበ፡ ምክር፡ አሐዱ፡ እስከ፡ ዕለተ፡ ኩናኔ፡
verses.translit: wa-yəbē ʾəgziʾ ʾamlākəna nāhu ḥəzbə ʾaḥadu wa-ləssān ʾaḥadu la-kwəlomu wa-zəntu ʾaḫazu yəgbaru wa-ʾalbo zayəkəlomu nāhu nərad wa-nəbāləḫomu ləssānomu kama ʾi-yəsmaʿu ʾaḥadu qāla kāləʾu wa-yəzarawə wəsta makānāt wa-wəsta ḥəzabāt wa-ʾi-yətbāʾas la-lomu kāʿba məkr ʾaḥadu ʾəska ʿəlata kwənnānē
verses.notes: **'BEHOLD ONE PEOPLE, ONE LANGUAGE — LET US DESCEND AND CONFUSE THEIR SPEECH.'** Direct rewrite of Gen 11:6-7 with the divine plural ('let US descend'). **CROSS-CORPUS — DIVINE COUNCIL PLURAL**: cf. Gen 1:26, 3:22, 11:7; cf. 4Q403 (Songs of the Sabbath Sacrifice — divine plurals). The 'WE' indicates the angel-council.

verses.text_geez: ወወረደ፡ እግዚእ፡ ወወረድነ፡ ምስሌሁ፡ ለነፂር፡ ሀገረ፡ ወማኅፈደ፡ ዘሐነጹ፡ ደቂቀ፡ ሰብእ፡
verses.translit: wa-warada ʾəgziʾ wa-waradna məslēhu la-naṣir hagara wa-māḫfada zaḥanaḍu daqiqa sabʾ
verses.notes: **'The Lord came down — AND WE DESCENDED WITH HIM.'** The angel-of-presence narrator places himself in the divine descent. cf. Gen 11:5.

verses.text_geez: ወባልኆ፡ ኵሎ፡ ቃላተ፡ ልሳኖሙ፡ ወአልቦ፡ ዘሰምዐ፡ አሐዱ፡ ቃለ፡ ካልኡ፡ ወአስተአተቱ፡ እምነ፡ ነዲቆ፡ ሀገር፡ ወማኅፈድ፡
verses.translit: wa-bāləḫo kwəlo qālāta ləssānomu wa-ʾalbo zasamʿa ʾaḥadu qāla kāləʾu wa-ʾastaʾtatu ʾəm-nə nadiqo hagar wa-māḫfad
verses.notes: **Languages confused; tower-building halted.** cf. Gen 11:7-8.

verses.text_geez: በእንተ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ተሰምየ፡ ኵሉ፡ ምድር፡ ዘሺንዐር፡ ባቤል፡ እስመ፡ ህየ፡ ባልኀ፡ እግዚእ፡ ኵሉ፡ ልሳነ፡ ደቂቀ፡ ሰብእ፡ ወእምህየ፡ ዘረውዎሙ፡ ውስተ፡ ኵሉ፡ ሀገሮሙ፡ በከመ፡ ልሳኖሙ፡ ወመነበሪሆሙ፡
verses.translit: ba-ʾənta zəntu tasamya kwəlu mədr zaŠinʿar Bābēl ʾəsma həya bāləḫa ʾəgziʾ kwəlu ləssāna daqiqa sabʾ wa-ʾəmhəya zarawəwomu wəsta kwəlu hagaromu ba-kama ləssānomu wa-manabarihomu
verses.notes: **'Therefore the land was called BABEL — because there the Lord CONFUSED their language.'** Direct citation of Gen 11:9 — the Hebrew etymology בָּבֶל Babel ← בלל balal 'confuse.'

verses.text_geez: ወአፍተተ፡ እግዚእ፡ ነፋሰ፡ ዐቢየ፡ ዘይከውን፡ ላዕለ፡ ማኅፈድ፡ ወአውድቆ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡ ወናሁ፡ ሀለወ፡ ማእከለ፡ አሱር፡ ወባቤል፡ ውስተ፡ ምድር፡ ሺንዐር፡ ወሰመይዎ፡ ስሞ፡ ምሥቃት፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾaftata ʾəgziʾ nafāsa ʿabəya zayəkawwən lāʿla māḫfad wa-ʾawdaqo lāʿla mədr wa-nāhu hallawa māʾkala ʾAsur wa-Bābēl wəsta mədr Šinʿar wa-samayəwo səmō Məśqāt
verses.notes: **'The Lord sent a great wind that overthrew the tower; it stands between Asshur and Babel in Shinar — called THE OVERTHROW (məśqāt).'** **MAJOR JUBILEES-DISTINCTIVE — THE TOWER WAS PHYSICALLY DESTROYED BY DIVINE WIND.** **CROSS-CORPUS — 'OVERTHROW' (Hebrew מַפֶּלֶת mappelet) MOTIF**: cf. Sib. Or. 3:97-104 (Tower fall by wind); cf. Josephus Ant. 1.118 (winds throw down Tower); cf. b. Sanh. 109a (Tower divided into 3 parts). **The wind-overthrow tradition is widely paralleled but NOT in Gen 11 itself — Genesis only describes language-confusion + dispersion.**

verses.text_geez: ወበ፴ ወ፬ ኢዮቤልዉ፡ በቀዳማዊ፡ ሰቡዕ፡ ቅሉጥ፡ ኮኑ፡ መንገለ፡ ሊባኖስ፡ ወመንገለ፡ ሐበሰ፡ ምድር፡ ዘሐም፡ ወድኅረዝ፡ ካዕበ፡ መንገለ፡ መካን፡ ዘዕፆሙ፡ ወረከበ፡ ከንዓን፡ ምድረ፡ ሊባኖስ፡ መንገለ፡ ግብጽ፡ ሠናየ፡ ጥቀ፡ ወኢሖረ፡ ውስተ፡ ዕፁ፡ ምድር፡ መንገለ፡ ምዕራብ፡ ባሕር፡ አላ፡ ኀደረ፡ ምድረ፡ ሊባኖስ፡ መንገለ፡ ምሥራቅ፡ ወመንገለ፡ ምዕራብ፡
verses.translit: wa-ba-34 ʾiyobēləwu ba-qadāmāwi sabuʿ qəluṭ konu mangala Libānos wa-mangala ḥabasa mədr zaḤam wa-dəḫrazə kāʿba mangala makān zaʿəḍomu wa-rakaba Kanʿān mədra Libānos mangala Gəbṣ śannāya ṭəqqa wa-ʾi-ḥora wəsta ʿəḍu mədr mangala məʿrāb bāḥr ʾallā ḫadara mədra Libānos mangala məsərāq wa-mangala məʿrāb
verses.notes: **CANAAN'S TERRITORIAL TRESPASS RESUMED.** After Babel, Canaan refuses to go to his African-coast allotment and settles in Lebanon-Levant instead. **Continues Jub 7:13.**

verses.text_geez: ወይቤልዎ፡ ሐም፡ ወካን፡ ወያፌት፡ አኀዊሁ፡ በውስተ፡ ምድር፡ ዘአኮ፡ መክፈልትከ፡ ኀደርከ፡ እመነ፡ ዕፅከ፡ አኮ፡ ወፅአ፡ ይከውን፡ እምነ፡ ቦቱ፡ ኢተግበር፡ ከመዝ፡ ወእመ፡ ገበርከ፡ አንተ፡ ወውሉድከ፡ ትወድቅ፡ ውስተ፡ መካን፡ ዘዘ፡ በምድረ፡ ወረጉማነ፡ ላዕለ፡ መርገም፡ ትከውን፡
verses.translit: wa-yəbēləwo Ḥam wa-Kān wa-Yāfet ʾəḫawihu ba-wəsta mədr za-ʾakko makfaltka ḫadarkka ʾəmena ʿəḍəka ʾakko waḍʾa yəkawwən ʾəm-nə bottu ʾi-təgbar kamazə wa-ʾəmma gabarkka ʾanta wa-wəludəka təwadəq wəsta makān zaza ba-mədra wa-ragumāna lāʿla margam təkawwən
verses.notes: **Canaan rebuked by Ham + family.** Strong territorial-trespass condemnation.

verses.text_geez: ወኢሰምዐ፡ ኪያሆሙ፡ ወኀደረ፡ ምድረ፡ ሊባኖስ፡ እምነ፡ ሐማት፡ እስከ፡ መግቢአ፡ ግብጽ፡ ውእቱ፡ ወውሉዱ፡ እስከ፡ ዮም፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾi-samʿa kiyāhomu wa-ḫadara mədra Libānos ʾəm-nə Ḥamāt ʾəska magbiʾa Gəbṣ wəʾtu wa-wəludu ʾəska yom
verses.notes: **Canaan disregards rebuke + settles in Lebanon-to-Egypt — i.e., the Levant.** Permanent trespass-residence.

verses.text_geez: በእንተ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ተሰምየት፡ ምድር፡ ይእቲ፡ ዘከንዓን፡
verses.translit: ba-ʾənta zəntu tasamyat mədr yəʾəti zaKanʿān
verses.notes: **'Therefore the land is called CANAAN.'** Etymology + ground for later conquest.

verses.text_geez: ወያፌትሰ፡ ወውሉዱ፡ ዘመረ፡ መንገለ፡ ባሕር፡ ወኀደረ፡ ምድረ፡ ዕፁ፡ ወረከበ፡ ማዳይ፡ ምድረ፡ ቅሩበ፡ ለባሕር፡ ወአስተአተተ፡ ቆደቆዶ፡ ይእቲ፡ መንገለ፡ ሰሜን፡ ወኢሰምዕዎ፡ አኀዊሁ፡ ለሎቱ፡ ወይቤልዎ፡ ኢተግባእ፡ ዕፆሙ፡
verses.translit: wa-Yāfetəsa wa-wəludu zammara mangala bāḥr wa-ḫadara mədra ʿəḍu wa-rakaba Mādāy mədra qərruba la-bāḥr wa-ʾastaʾtata qodaqodo yəʾəti mangala saymən wa-ʾi-samʿəwo ʾəḫawihu la-lottu wa-yəbēləwo ʾi-tagbāʾ ʿəḍomu
verses.notes: **MADAI (Japhetite) trespasses too — settles south near Shem-territory.** Multiple trespasses noted. Jubilees-distinctive geographical-realignment.

verses.text_geez: ወኀደረ፡ ምድረ፡ ዘሴም፡ ወሐርየ፡ ኪያሁ፡ ሴም፡ ወይቤሎ፡ ኀደር፡ ዕፅከ፡ ግፍ፡ ላዕሌየ፡ ወአፍቅረከ፡ ግፍ፡ ላዕሌየ፡
verses.translit: wa-ḫadara mədra zaSēm wa-ḥarya kiyāhu Sēm wa-yəbēlo ḫadar ʿəḍəka gəfə lāʿlēya wa-ʾafaqqərkka gəfə lāʿlēya
verses.notes: **Madai requests permission from Shem; Shem grants permission to settle his allotment.** Madai's settlement is REGULARIZED by Shem-permission (unlike Canaan's). Hence Madai-territory becomes 'Media' in Shem's range.

verses.text_geez: ወአቀመ፡ ሎቱ፡ ምድረ፡ መንግሥቱ፡ ወውሉዱ፡ መንግሥቱ፡ ሐርያ፡ ቅድሜሁ፡ ወሰመይዎ፡ ለመንግሥቱ፡ ማዳይ፡ ለርእስ፡ አበዊሁ፡ እስከ፡ ዮም፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾaqama lottu mədra mangəśtu wa-wəludu mangəśtu ḥaryā qədmēhu wa-samayəwo la-mangəśtu Mādāy la-rəʾəsa ʾabawihu ʾəska yom
verses.notes: **Madai's kingdom (Media) established legitimately.** Closes ch 10.

verses.text_geez: ወአልቦ፡ ካልአ፡ ምንተኒ፡ ምን፡ ሰማዕነ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡ መንግሥቶሙ፡ ለደቂቀ፡ ኖኅ፡ እምነ፡ ዕለታት፡ ኖኅ፡ እስከ፡ ዕለታት፡ አብርሃም፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾalbo kāləʾa məntani mən samāʿna lāʿla mədr mangəśtomu la-daqiqa Noḫ ʾəm-nə ʿəlatāt Noḫ ʾəska ʿəlatāt ʾAbrəhām
verses.notes: **'And we heard nothing else from the days of Noah to the days of Abraham.'** **Transition formula to ch 11 (Abraham birth).** The angel-of-presence narrator wraps up the post-Flood frame.
